card.name: Small words right before 'touch' or 'look'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'can't', 'when' or 'upon' where the next word could plausibly be touch, look at, or contact, usually after words about pain, sensitivity, or things too awful to see.

modes.label: Can't or too much to look at
modes.description: A word like 'can't' or 'to' after an adjective, where the next word would be a verb of looking or showing.
modes.example: If you just can<<'t>> look at that, here's a link

modes.label: Safe or painful to touch
modes.description: 'to' or 'when' after safe, sensitive or tender, where touch or pressure is likely next.
modes.example: non-thermal, room-temperature plasma that’s safe<< to>> touch.

modes.label: Pain upon contact
modes.description: A linking word after 'pain' or 'tenderness' that leads into contact, pressure or movement.
modes.example: A sensation of tenderness in the heel area, especially<< when>> it is subjected to pressure.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'touch', 'touching' or 'touched' next, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a likely 'touch', as in 'safe to touch' or 'painful when touched'.
